title: Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in Gaza kills surgeon and five others
summary_full: Hospital director says 28 wounded in attack on one of few remaining medical facilities in the stripAn Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in southern Gaza killed six people, including a surgeon and a disabled man, and wounded 28 others, according to the hospital director.The Israeli military carried out the attack on the hospital, in Khan Younis, early on Thursday saying in a statement it had struck a Hamas commander and other fighters there, without providing evidence.
